about: Joey64 per-game database: what each game needs, what is wrong with it and where, and what was fixed. Seed for the M3 profile DB. Rules: gamedb/README.md. Update this file in the same commit as any change to a game's status (new problem found, fixed, regressed, setting added or dropped).

games.title: Pokemon Snap

settings.what: synchronous parallel-RDP (smart sync), also in fast-forward
settings.why: photo checks read the framebuffer; async can hand the CPU a stale one

issues.what: Oak's Mark photo check not yet checked under smart sync (Snap moved from plain sync to smart sync)
issues.evidence: README Pokemon Snap photo check item

issues.what: Oak's Mark fix (upstream PRs gonetz/GLideN64#2991, libretro #674) not rechecked after the gonetz update, core d8f51f5

notes: VI filters off: +20% speed on the Flip, the biggest gain of the 14 bench games (2026-11-05, vifilt)

settings.why: async: halts on a 'secret cheat, power off' screen after ~10 s

fixed.what: ran at 121 fps on 120 Hz screens (audio did not pace it)
fixed.fix: speed cap when audio does not pace, app 0985fb0

issues.what: rooms in gameplay (pre-rendered backgrounds + 3D) only checked up to the intro video and save screen; check in-game from a save, also on the Flip
async with texture load snapshots (N64_RDP_TEX_SNAPSHOT=1): plays on the Duo, still black on the Flip, so it stays synchronous
bench state stops on the Controller Pak notice, so its bench numbers are a static menu (150-1190 fps swings); needs a state in a race

fixed.what: RSP looped on the boot screen with precise smart sync
fixed.fix: copies (DMA, RSP, C code) always wait, core 2938164

settings.what: synchronous parallel-RDP on every GPU, also in fast-forward
settings.where: kSyncRdpGames (was kAdrenoSyncGames, Adreno fast-forward only, until 2026-11-05)
settings.why: async: intro draws, then black (Odin 3 and Duo 2026-11-03, every Flip run since 2026-11-05)

settings.what: save type 16K EEPROM for hacks (header ID)
settings.why: hacks not in the database got 4K and could not save

settings.what: smoother timing, CountPerOp=1 (counter factor 1), on Adreno 730 and up (Portal, Odin 3, Thor) only
settings.why: Odin 3 28.6 -> 30.0 fps; compat with it passed on the Odin 3 and Portal (odin3-/portal-smoothc), Joey 2026-11-06. Hacks with this ID get it too

fixed.what: draws its intro, then every frame black from ~25 s with async parallel-RDP (repeat skip off: still black, so not the skip; sync: plays)
fixed.fix: added to kSyncRdpGames, app f6b99e6; flip-blk-def/noskip/sync; default build checked: draws to the end (flip-sync6)

games.title: Spider-Man

settings.what: synchronous parallel-RDP on every GPU, also in fast-forward
settings.why: async: intro draws, then black (Portal 2026-11-03, every Flip run since 2026-11-05)

fixed.what: intro, then every frame black from ~25 s with async parallel-RDP; sync plays it
fixed.fix: added to kSyncRdpGames, app f6b99e6; flip-blk-*; default build checked: draws to the end (flip-sync6)

notes: Flip with sync: 58.4-58.6 emu fps average, lowest 5 s window 49.3-53.5 (flip-blk-sync, flip-sync6)

settings.what: cached interpreter instead of the dynarec
settings.why: new_dynarec jumps to a bogus address right after boot since upstream's 3.0 core update

issues.what: find the dynarec commit that broke it, fix, report upstream (then drop the interpreter setting)

games.title: Perfect Dark

fixed.what: judder at 60 fps: audio every other frame (0, then 1474 samples) made audio sync start frames 5 then 28 ms apart, ~240 of 300 frames uneven per 5 s
fixed.fix: smoothed audio wait, automatic above 60 Hz, app 6de8bb8. Duo: uneven 244 -> 39, lag 20.2 -> 18.6 ms; Odin 3: 246 -> 28, lag 18.3 -> 15.7 ms; 0 underruns; same-build underrun A/B clean (chain72)

fixed.what: Portal: menu background shifted down (async build of 2026-11-03)

notes: input delay steady 18-24 ms (Smash 16-18); an earlier 54-83 ms was an averaging artifact
Flip slow frames are a first-run dynarec compile burst (2009 blocks / 273 ms in one window), like MK64
100-140 ms boot frames on the Flip

games.title: Ocarina of Time
notes: reads its depth buffer every frame (lens flare): smart sync waits 599 of 600 frames; lazy waking of the RDP worker costs it 3% on the Portal (Snap 15%, GoldenEye 6%: games where the CPU waits on GPU results)
hacks Sands of Time, Sealed Palace, Master of Time, Missing Link, Dawn & Dusk share the CZL ID: tell them apart by crc

settings.why: Odin 3 26.5 -> 28.1 fps; compat with it passed on the Odin 3 and Portal (odin3-/portal-smoothc), Joey 2026-11-06. Hacks with this ID get it too

issues.what: hitch the first time an area's code runs: ~2100 dynarec blocks compiled at once (not code thrown away and rebuilt). A one-off per area; fixes: compile thread (item 7) or saved block list (item 17)

notes: first launch: 98-100 ms worst frame on the Flip while shaders compile (warm 40-41 ms)
maybe a white dash on the bottom lines of the race view on all devices (low confidence)

games.title: Smash Remix 0.9.4 (hack)
notes: Project64 marks it Unaligned DMA=1, our ini aligns it (item 26). Flip 2026-11-06, N64_PI_DMA_DEBUG=1, aligned and kept odd: no PI DMA from an odd cart address through boot, the menus and into a 1P match (Ness, 60 fps), same screens either way, so the setting cannot matter and the ini entry stays (results/pialign/flip1, flip2)

issues.what: Project64 runs it at counter factor 2, we use CountPerOp 1: check for timing problems

With the VI fix: 60 fps with no underruns, then 48-51 emu fps in one scene where the Flip itself is busy (11-12 ms a frame, the device's limit); Flip flip-dd11/flip-dd16 (2026-11-07, core dd 0ac9d17 = VI event removed by type + Doshin CountPerOp 1)

games.title: Kyojin no Doshin (64DD)

settings.what: CountPerOp=1 (counter factor 1), retail and store demo disks
settings.where: core mupen64plus.ini (both copies), by disk md5
settings.why: at 2 the game crashes loading after Start; Project64's database gives the Doshin cartridge conversions Counter Factor 1

notes: Flip: boots, intro then "Now loading", 61 emu fps; flip-dd1 / flip-dd2 (2026-11-07, app dd + core dd e33750, IPL_JPN = Japan v1.2)
Was ~15 fps with a quarter of its audio: the core's VI event got duplicated, so the game took one VI interrupt in four (fixed in core dd 7a8c4ba, not a 64DD problem; README 64DD item)

With the VI fix alone it crashed while loading after Start (reads through a bad pointer, also on the cached interpreter); CountPerOp 1 loads it: intro and play at 60 fps, 0 underruns, retail and kiosk demo; Flip flip-dd11/flip-dd16 (2026-11-07, core dd 0ac9d17 = VI event removed by type + Doshin CountPerOp 1)

Thor (2026-11-07, app 9263f30 + core dd ddf3103, before the VI event fix in core dd 7a8c4ba, IPL_JPN = Japan v1.2, 30-60 s from the start): intro at 30 s, 61 emu fps, 15 drawn (as on the Flip); the Demo (Kiosk) [b] and Kaihou Sensen [b] disks the same

Thor (2026-11-07, app e02f8ec + core dd 0ac9d17 = VI event fix + Doshin CountPerOp 1, IPL_JPN = Japan v1.2, started by intent, 30 and 60 s): title menu at 30 s, 60 emu fps, 60 drawn (was 15 before the fix); the Demo (Kiosk) [b] and Kaihou Sensen [b] disks the same
